For a new Indian clothing store, I’d shortlist:

Razorpay — Best all-rounder. Supports UPI, cards, wallets and net banking; standard pricing is around 2% + GST, with ₹0 setup/AMC. 
Razorpay

Cashfree — Strong on UPI + Shopify/e-commerce and currently offers promotional 0% platform fees for eligible new merchants up to ₹20 lakh/month. 
Cashfree
+1

PhonePe Payment Gateway — Good if UPI is your priority; supports UPI, cards and net banking, with Shopify/WooCommerce integrations and promotional zero-fee pricing. 
PhonePe

What to compare: total fee + GST, payment-success rate, settlement time, refund/chargeback fees, Shopify integration, customer support, and international-card support.

My pick: Cashfree for a cost-conscious launch; Razorpay if you want the broader ecosystem.

Three strong anniversary-gift options under ₹15,000:

Dior Sauvage EDP 100ml — ₹14,200 at Sephora India. Rich, woody-spicy and instantly recognisable; a strong choice for a more classic luxury feel. 
Sephora India

Yves Saint Laurent Libre EDP 90ml — around ₹13,200. Floral, warm and sophisticated, with a more romantic anniversary-gift character. 
Sephora India

Narciso Rodriguez For Her Musc Noir Rose EDP 100ml — ₹9,850. Musky, soft and intimate; feels less mainstream and more personal. 
Sephora India

Gift vibe: Dior = iconic, YSL = romantic, Narciso = intimate/understated.
